name: login-01
title: Login 01 - The Screen Where A Person Authorises A Machine
description: A sign-in: a caller-declared identifier field, a secret with a reveal control named in the caller's own language, an optional remember row, one submit control, an announced status region, and slots for a second factor and a provider row whose marks are the caller's licensed assets. The Block will not rate-limit, will not decide whether the identifier exists and will not say whether the secret was right, because a Block that made any of those three would be a rate limiter, an account directory and a password verifier in a component library. There is no failure sentence anywhere in the file: the outcome is a prop, so the sentence about a refused sign-in is the product's own. Every string is passed in as a prop.
